description: Rochester, NY – Today, New York State United Teachers (NYSUT) endorsed Joe Morelle’s candidacy for Congress in the 25th District. Representing more than 600,000 members, including almost 30,000 in Monroe County, NYSUT is committed to improving the quality of education and healthcare in New York State.

title: NYSUT Endorses Morelle - Joe Morelle for Congress
